responsibility: This header declares the public identifier interning interface for GCC’s string pool. It exposes lookup and creation of unique IDENTIFIER_NODEs by name or known length, plus the constant-string macro wrapper that routes literal names to the length-aware entry point for efficiency. It is the lightweight frontend and middle-end interface to the identifier pool implemented in stringpool.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/stringpool.cc, which implements and stores the identifier hash table and its GC/PCH machinery, this header is just the public front-end declaration layer for identifier lookup/creation entry points and the constant-string get_identifier macro optimization.
